releases.notes:
### New
- [Extra Delight](https://modrinth.com/mod/extradelight)'s mixing bowl, vat, melting pot and oven are stations: stir with the spoon, age in stages under the lid, melt chocolate, bake in its pans.
- [Sable Trees](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/sable-trees)' chopping block is a station: food is cut along its marks and an axe splits a log like a pie.
- [Cooking for Blockheads](https://modrinth.com/mod/cooking-for-blockheads)'s oven is a station: food bakes on its rack, fuel goes in at the fire, and it bakes Farmer's Delight's campfire dishes too.
- [Hearth and Harvest](https://modrinth.com/mod/hearth-and-harvest)'s keg, big keg and cask are stations: drinks ferment under the lid and age sealed in the cask ([#28](https://github.com/Pocky-l/handson-delight/issues/28)).
- [Twilight's Flavor & Delight](https://modrinth.com/mod/twilight-delight)'s maze stove is a station, and Twilight food still grills twice as fast on it.
- [Trail&Tales Delight](https://modrinth.com/mod/trailtales-delight)'s mud stove is a stove station.
- The recipe book can be searched, shows only what you can make now on a switch, and keeps a tab of the dishes made lately.
- A click on a thing that goes in opens its own recipe, when the book has one.

### Changed
- The book's pages turn with Page Up and Page Down, Home and End, or a held click on either half of the page's foot.
- The book's foot shows the page out of how many, each tab opens where you left it, and dishes you can make come first.
- Tabs are named under the cursor, an empty tab is hidden, and a long row of tabs scrolls with the mouse wheel or the arrows at its ends.
- At the ovens of Extra Delight and Cultural Delights a right click lays one thing, the pan comes from your inventory, and a finished set goes in by itself.

### Fixed
- A keg's tap no longer hangs the server when [Brewin' and Chewin'](https://modrinth.com/mod/brewin-and-chewin)'s output slot is full. Thanks to LeDok ([#39](https://github.com/Pocky-l/handson-delight/pull/39)).
- [More Delight](https://modrinth.com/mod/more-delight)'s fried egg no longer cooks on into an omelette in the skillet or on the stove ([#33](https://github.com/Pocky-l/handson-delight/issues/33)).
- A full cooking pot, keg or kettle takes what its dish still needs ([#34](https://github.com/Pocky-l/handson-delight/issues/34)).
- [Gensokyo Delight: Youkai's Feasts](https://modrinth.com/mod/gensokyo-delight-youkais-feasts)' flask fills at its tank and kettle, and its sauce flasks work at its cuisine board ([#33](https://github.com/Pocky-l/handson-delight/issues/33)).
- The cutting board takes what a dish needs in any order.
- [JEI](https://modrinth.com/mod/jei) showed the cutting board's dishes in the crafting table as well.
- [Farmer's Respite](https://modrinth.com/mod/farmers-respite-unofficial-port)'s kettle could keep 250 mB that would not pour out ([#31](https://github.com/Pocky-l/handson-delight/issues/31)).
- A milk bucket on the cooking pot makes [Brazilian Delight](https://modrinth.com/mod/braziliandelight)'s milk pot again.
- In a LAN game, a guest who turned the cutting board off can craft its dishes in the crafting grid again.
- Switching quickly between neighbouring stations no longer breaks the recipe book.
- With Trail&Tales Delight, stone lies down on the cutting board again to be broken with a pickaxe.

releases.notes:
### New
- [Cultural Delights](https://modrinth.com/mod/cultural-delights)' oven is a station: lay the food on its tray, shut
  the door and watch it bake through the grate.
- Cultural Delights' vat is a station: pour, drop the ingredients in, close the lid and draw the drink with a bottle.
- [Farmer's Respite](https://modrinth.com/mod/farmers-respite-unofficial-port)'s kettle is a station: lift the lid, pour
  the water in, drop the leaves in and pour the tea from the spout. `kettle_time` in the config sets how long it brews.
- [Gensokyo Delight: Youkai's Feasts](https://modrinth.com/mod/gensokyo-delight-youkais-feasts): its kettle, cuisine
  board, iron pots, stockpot, steamer and fermentation tank are stations.
- Youkai's Feasts' hint squares beside its blocks are hidden; `youkai_hints=true` in the config brings them back.
- [Barbeque's Delight](https://modrinth.com/mod/barbeques-delight-forge)'s grill and ingredients basin are stations: turn and season the skewers, thread them
  from the basin.
- [Farmer's Spell 'n Spell Book](https://modrinth.com/mod/farmers-spell)'s alchemist pot is a station, and a scroll of
  [Iron's Spells 'n Spellbooks](https://modrinth.com/mod/irons-spells-n-spellbooks) hung on it unlocks its dishes.
- [Chopper's Delight](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/choppers-delight)'s decorated cutting board works like any other board.
- [Dungeons Delight](https://modrinth.com/mod/dungeons_delight)'s dungeon stove is a station.
- The recipe book can be resized and moved; a right click on its cover puts it back.

### Changed
- The recipe book opens almost twice as fast and opens at the recipe you picked last.
- The first click on a recipe in the book shows its page, the second lays it out from your inventory.
- The mouse wheel turns the book's pages, and its items show their names under the cursor.

### Fixed
- Raw chicken stayed whole on the cutting board with [PizzaCraft](https://modrinth.com/mod/pizzacraft).
- [Christmas Delight](https://modrinth.com/mod/christmas-delight)'s milk dishes could not be cooked at all.
- KubeJS and [CraftTweaker](https://modrinth.com/mod/crafttweaker) recipe changes reach the cutting board.
- [Brewin' and Chewin'](https://modrinth.com/mod/brewin-and-chewin)'s keg and the cooking pot missed recipes that need two of the same item.
- Long ingredient lists ran off the book's page; they scroll now.
- The recipe book was hidden behind nearby blocks on some Macs ([#9](https://github.com/Pocky-l/handson-delight/issues/9)).
- A water bottle used at the cutting board gives back its glass, and [InvMove](https://modrinth.com/mod/invmove) no longer walks you away
  from a station ([#27](https://github.com/Pocky-l/handson-delight/issues/27)).
- Players without the mod lost the cutting board's dishes from their recipe book on join.
- The cutting board opens facing you from any side, and the knife stands right under the cursor.
- Many smaller fixes at the stations, and they cost less each frame.

- Raw chicken stayed whole on the cutting board with [PizzaCraft](https://modrinth.com/mod/pizzacraft).
- The cutting board had no dishes with KubeJS and [ModernFix](https://modrinth.com/mod/modernfix)
  ([#24](https://github.com/Pocky-l/handson-delight/issues/24)).
- KubeJS and [CraftTweaker](https://modrinth.com/mod/crafttweaker) recipe changes reach the cutting board.
- [Brewin' and Chewin'](https://modrinth.com/mod/brewin-and-chewin)'s keg and the cooking pot missed recipes that need
  two of the same item.
- Long ingredient lists ran off the book's page; they scroll now.
- The recipe book was hidden behind nearby blocks on some Macs ([#9](https://github.com/Pocky-l/handson-delight/issues/9)).
- A water bottle used at the cutting board gives back its glass, and [InvMove](https://modrinth.com/mod/invmove) no
  longer walks you away from a station ([#27](https://github.com/Pocky-l/handson-delight/issues/27)).
- Players without the mod lost the cutting board's dishes from their recipe book on join.
- A server crashed when another mod's fake player used a stove.
- The cutting board opens facing you from any side, and the knife stands right under the cursor.
- Many smaller fixes at the stations, and they cost less each frame.

releases.notes:
### New
- Modpacks can put any craft together on the cutting board: add its result to the item tag
  `handson_delight:assembled`, and every shaped or shapeless craft of it, from any mod, datapack or
  [KubeJS](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/kubejs) script, is made on the board. Before, the tag only
  worked for the recipes of Farmer's Delight and its addons. How to do it, and how to add recipes for the other
  stations, is in the README, under "Modpacks".
- Everything Farmer's Delight cuts on its board is worked at the cutting board now, not only food: logs and wood,
  flowers, stone and bricks, clay and gravel, doors, boats and carts with a chest, leather armour and saddles. Each tool
  has its own stroke: the axe strips a log down its side and splits wood with a swing, the pickaxe cracks stone with a
  few blows, the shovel digs a lump of clay smaller with each shovelful, the hoe hooks the chest off a boat and pries it
  away, the shears snip along their line. The book lists them after the kitchen's cuts.

### Changed
- Blocks lying on the cutting board (a pumpkin, a melon, a log) are drawn smaller, so the tool over them stays in sight.
- Drawing a drink at [Brewin' and Chewin'](https://modrinth.com/mod/brewin-and-chewin)'s keg is a small pleasure
  now: the tankard comes under the tap the moment you click, tipped in, the drink runs into it and rises as it is set
  upright, a beer's head of foam builds up to the rim, the last drops fall, and the full tankard goes back to your hand
  or your inventory. With Shift the tankards come one after the other.
- Each of the keg's drinks looks like itself: beer golden under a head of foam with bubbles rising, stout nearly black,
  vodka clear, egg grog thick and creamy, grenadine glittering. While a beer brews, a yeast head grows on it and
  settles brown before it is done.
- The keg comes shut, as it stands: click its lid to lift it off and lean it against the keg's side, click it again
  to put it back. Things go in at the top only with the lid off, and a brew ferments only under its lid, as a real one
  is kept shut; the last one to leave puts the lid back. A recipe picked in the book takes the lid off by itself.
- A working brew lets off its gas now and then, at the station and to whoever passes by: the lid knocks up, foam fizzes
  out along its seam with a soft blub, foam beads at the tap; a quiet keg is one that is too cold or too warm to work.
  Meat and fish curing in a dry keg breathe a thin warm wisp instead, and lie on slats across its top.
- The keg's badge shows what it makes, how warm the keg is against what the recipe takes, how far it has fermented and
  the minutes and seconds left; with a drink in the keg, how many servings there are. When something is done it swells
  with a chime and glints.
- A bucket or bottle is tipped over the keg's rim and pours in; things dropped in splash in the drink's own colour and
  send rings across it. Its walls are one pixel thick with an inside of their own, and a full keg is filled three
  quarters up, so the drink no longer brims at the lid. Water looks dark and clear as in wood, honey deep amber. The
  camera looks at the keg from three quarters, with the tankard under the tap in view.
- The recipe book comes in shut and opens before your eyes, and its pages are laid out evenly: the list in the middle
  of its page, what a dish is served in and how long it takes centred at the foot, on one line with the page arrows.

### Fixed
- The keg and the skillet look the same at the station as in the world: they no longer light up as you come, nor
  blink or show twice as you come and go.
- A click on the recipe book picks what is under the cursor also near the outer edges of its pages, which rise a
  little, instead of the dish above or below it.

mods.description: Cook in Farmer's Delight with your hands: its menus become interactive in-world stations.

releases.notes:
### New
- [Brewin' and Chewin'](https://modrinth.com/mod/brewin-and-chewin)'s keg opens as a station, lying or standing: its
  lid swings open on the liquid, a bucket or bottle pours in at the opening, the ingredients float while it ferments and
  the liquid takes the drink's colour. Its badge shows how warm the keg is and how warm the recipe wants it. Draw drinks
  at the tap, one or, with Shift, as many as there are. Its recipes are in the book, with their liquid, warmth and time.
- [Miner's Delight](https://modrinth.com/mod/miners-delight)'s copper pot opens as a cooking pot station: four
  ingredients, stirred as one batch, its soups served two copper cups a serving.
- Cooking times in the config: `cooking_pot_time`, `skillet_time` and `stove_time` in
  `config/handson_delight.properties` make food take longer (`2.0` twice as long) or shorter (`0.5` half) at the pot,
  the skillet and the stove. The pot follows it whether you stir or leave it alone, and the recipe books show the new
  times.
- [Barbeque's Delight](https://modrinth.com/mod/barbeques-delight-forge)'s kebab wrap, kebab sandwich
  and bibimbap are put together on the cutting board, with pages in its book. They keep the seasoning of the skewers
  that went into them.
- [Dungeons Delight](https://modrinth.com/mod/dungeons_delight)'s monster pot opens as a cooking pot station, in its
  own look: stir its monster food as one batch, with stars, its own recipes in the book. A spawner or its own fires
  heat it, as in Dungeons Delight.
- [Chopper's Delight](https://modrinth.com/mod/choppers-delight)'s cutting boards of every wood open as the board
  station, each in its own wood: cut, put dishes together and stick tools in as on Farmer's Delight's board. Its
  decorated board keeps its own use.
- Stick a tool into the cutting board at the station: hold a knife, a sword or an axe on the cursor and Shift + click the
  bare board. A click takes it out again, and food you put on the board takes it out into your inventory.
- A knife in your off hand cuts at the board, as a knife in your inventory does.
- With [Modest Meals](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/modest-meals) its sandwiches, salads, wraps, rolls,
  pies, cakes, pizzas and milkshakes are put together on the cutting board, as Farmer's Delight's burgers are: lay the
  bread, bowl or crust first, then the fillings, and the bread on top of a sandwich. Its hamburger, apple pie and the
  other dishes it makes of set fillings have pages in the board's book. The crafting table no longer makes its meals.

### Changed
- Going to a station and back is quicker and smoother: the camera sets off at once and lands softly, the recipe book
  and the pot's badge grow in as it arrives and go as you leave, instead of popping up and vanishing.
- The stations' recipe book is a cookbook of its own: green cloth covers with brass corners, gilt bands on the spine and
  a pot on the front, pages of fresh paper that fill the book with an even margin, and a frayed ribbon to close it.

### Fixed
- Recipe viewers such as [EMI](https://modrinth.com/mod/emi) show names for this mod's item tags, such as "Foods Cracked
  Open", instead of raw ids like `#handson_delight:cracked`.
- A right click on the cutting board with a knife no longer puts the knife on your cursor: it stays in your hand and
  shows over the food, so the first click cuts.
- A right click on the board with food lays it where a click at the station would: as the next layer of a dish being
  put together, or in place of a finished dish or a tool stuck in the board, which go to your inventory. Anything the
  board cannot use stays in your hand.
- A right click on the stove with a knife, a bowl or food that is not grilled opens the station instead of doing
  nothing, so you can go over from the board to the stove with the knife in hand.
- On Fabric the stations open on structures that [Sable](https://modrinth.com/mod/sable) moves, such as builds of
